metadata.purpose: Prepare the next ScenePattern parity slice for legacy CreateIK without bulk-copying its large UI-coupled implementation.
metadata.instruction: Inspect current AIMayaTool Setup/Scene primitives against legacy CreateIK. Identify reusable offset/group, joint-chain, IK handle, pole-vector, FK control, constraint, proxy-attribute, visibility, and space-switch primitives. Return a bounded migration decomposition and exact gaps; do not modify product code. Legacy CreateIK requires exactly three source objects and contains substantial NLTA/UI coupling, so prefer composition of existing clean primitives over copying the monolith. Do not use Codex.
acceptance: Current AIMayaTool reusable primitives are identified before implementation.
Useful legacy CreateIK behavior is separated from UI/serialization coupling.
Three-object and non-collinear geometry requirements are documented.
A bounded dependency-ready first implementation slice is specified without duplicating existing Setup helpers.
metadata.next_if_pass: Architect implements the smallest dependency-ready CreateIK composition slice using existing Setup primitives and adds focused deterministic verification before Maya validation.
